title: Ballyknockan, Valleymount, Co. Wicklow, W91X3W5
description:
Perched in an elevated position with sweeping views across the Blessington Lakes, this impressive home enjoys a truly picturesque setting, framed by mature lawned gardens and timeless granite stone walls. Thoughtfully designed for comfortable family living, the property extends to approximately 168 sq. m (1816 sq. ft). The layout cleverly separates the living and sleeping accommodation, offering both practicality and privacy. To the front, a bright and spacious living room is bathed in natural light, with windows on three sides perfectly capturing the stunning lake vistas. Behind this is the dining room which features an open fireplace and French doors that open onto the gardens, ideal for entertaining or enjoying quiet evenings. The adjoining kitchen is arranged in a classic L-shaped design, complete with solid wood cabinetry, a Stanley oil-fired range, and direct access to the rear garden. There are five double rooms, all finished with wooden flooring and some with fitted wardrobes. A recently upgraded family bathroom has been stylishly converted into a modern wet room with a walk-in shower and full tiling. This is complimented by a separate guest W.C.

While presented in excellent, move-in condition, the property also offers exciting potential for re-imagining into a contemporary open-plan home, allowing a new owner to fully capitalize on the breathtaking panoramic views. Outside, the expansive gardens are predominantly laid in lawn, offering ample space for recreation and relaxation. A hardcore driveway provides generous parking. 

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a home of character and potential in one of Wicklow’s most scenic and sought-after locations.

LOCATION:
This bungalow residence is located in one of the region's most spectacular locations overlooking Blessington lakes and the surrounding countryside. The panoramic views make this one of the most exceptional properties currently available in the area. Located in the beautiful stone village of Ballyknockan, the area is renowned for its scenic beauty with a host of local amenities such as Golf in the nearby Tulfarris & Blessington Lakes Golf Clubs, Horse Riding, Sailing, Hill walking and much more. It is within walking distance of the pub and all amenities. Valleymount and Lacken villages are both nearby with schools, shops and churches and the town of Blessington is also close by which offers churches, primary and secondary schools, pubs, restaurants and shops as well as the Town Centre development which includes Dunnes Stores and many other retailers.

Blessington: c. 7 miles. Dublin: c. 25 miles.

FEATURES:
•	Gardens extending to c. 0.81 Acre / 0.33 hectares. 
•	Large drive with ample parking.
•	Barna shed.
•	Mains Water.
•	Sewage: Septic tank.
•	Oil fired central heating.
